scenario: Enemy soldiers have taken over my village and will kill all civilians above the age of two. I and ten neighbors are hiding in two rooms of the cellar of a large house. I can hear the voices of soldiers who have come to search the house for valuables. My baby begins to cry loudly. The crying will attract the attention of the soldiers, who will spare my baby’s life, but will kill me and the other refugees in both rooms. If I activate a noisy boiler it will cushion the crying, but it will become uncomfortably hot. The heat will be mortal for my baby, but it will save me and the ten neighbors.
choice: I decide to cushion the crying by activating the noisy boiler which will asphyxiate the baby
entities: 1 narrator,1 baby,10 neighbors/refugees hiding in the two cellar rooms,unknown number of enemy soldiers searching the house,i
outcomes: The soldiers are not drawn to the cellar by the crying
